resources.string: Your TV, laid out around what you actually watch. First, how should it look? You can change this any time.
On a controller, A chooses, B goes back, Y opens a tile\'s options, Start searches and Select opens Settings.
Each one adds a part of the home screen. Nothing leaves this TV; say no to any of them.
Power Setup, the next step, can allow any of these as well.
Done: pressing Home brings Lounge up. Power Setup can also allow the accesses from the last step, and turn the TV on and switch its input.
Google TV has no setting for this. Power Setup can do it through the TV\'s USB debugging, and the TV asks you once: tick “Always allow”, then choose Allow.
Waiting for you to allow it…
Android didn\'t make Lounge the home screen. Try again, or in Settings open Default home screen for other ways.

plurals.item: This TV\'s own home comes before any chosen one, so Lounge turns %1$s off too. Nothing is uninstalled; to turn it back on, in Settings open Power Setup, and do that before you uninstall Lounge.

resources.string: The TV\'s own home screen stays installed, so casting, the gear button and the TV guide keep working. To undo this, in Settings open Power Setup.
Scan the code with your phone\'s camera. Your phone becomes a remote and a keyboard, and the place to arrange rows and install plugins.
Turn on the phone companion to show a code for your phone to scan. Your phone becomes a remote and a keyboard, and the place to arrange rows and install plugins.
Everything stays on your home network. To forget a phone later, in Settings open Phone companion.
Press Home any time to come back to the Stage. Hold OK on a tile for its menu, Settings has the essentials, and the rest is on your phone.
Up from the Stage reaches Search and Settings.
Up from the Stage reaches Search, TV controls and Settings.
Up from the Stage reaches Search, the TV guide and Settings.
Up from the Stage reaches Search, the TV guide, TV controls and Settings.
Back always goes up one level; from the rows it returns to the Stage.
Plugins bring in your media server, live TV and the lights at home. In Settings, open Plugins.
